liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Alabama Getaway** (1 review): The opening Alabama Getaway is fast-paced and highly jammable by Jerry and Brent [11]
- **C C Rider** (1 review): The listener considers this their new favorite C C Rider performance [14]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The second set features a good old Scarlet Begonias into Fire On The Mountain [11]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): The setlist shows a range of tempo, from Fire to a slo-mo Ship of Fools [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-12-26.121533.matrix.tobin.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 163 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1980-12-26.nak300.walker-scotton.miller.89260.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 165 min; rated 4.09/5 by 22 [4]. Said about its sound: The recording quality is good enough for a listener with tinnitus to hear clearly; The recording is crispy and was replayed with azimuth fine-tuning on a DR-1; The audience explodes two or three times, adding energy typical of audience recordings [12][13][17]
- **gd1980-12-26.nak300.aolong.34400.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 164 min [5]
- **gd1980-12-26.176075.sbd.deluca.miller.clugston.phase.repair.pced.patched.flac1644**: soundboard; 22 songs; 166 min [7]
- **gd1980-12-26.157697.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 160 min [8]

## Around the show

- The audience seemed grateful that day after Christmas, with a nice amount of people [13]
- The listener was in SW Florida on a very rainy morning while listening [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-12-26.121533.matrix.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 3 Source Mix - SBD1 (shn id 17279) MSR>C>DAT>WAV>SHN w/ Aud Patch - NAK 700's FOB>MAC>C>DAT>WAV>SHN. C>SHN Conversion by Cousinit + SBD2 Mono from Video… [1]. Also: The recording was mixed by an archive.org user [1]
- **gd1980-12-26.nak300.walker-scotton.miller.89260.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Nakamichi 300/CP1 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/Maxell UDXL-II90) [4]
- **gd1980-12-26.nak300.aolong.34400.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Paul Scotton; source: Nak 300's > D5 > ACM [5]. Also: Paul transferred Joani's AMC using a Sony KA2ES and Marantz CDR500 Pro; Joani Walker recorded the show, and the transfer is a minor fix of the Walker-Vernon source; The only fix was to smooth the splice in Space [5][10]
- **gd1980-12-26.176075.sbd.deluca.miller.clugston.phase.repair.pced.patched.flac1644**: taped by Jeff Hellman, Dan DeLuca; transferred by Vocal Phase Repair by Charlie Miller January 2026 Mastered by Scott Clugston January 2026; source: Jeff Hellman's 1st generation Soundboard Cassettes (dolby B) > Dan DeLuca's 2nd generation reels > DAT [7]. Also: Richie Stankiewicz provided a FOB Beyer M160 source for Alabama Getaway and Promised Land; Kevin Tobin supplied a mono VHS soundboard for Lost Sailor, Saint Of Circumstance, and Deal; Joani Walker, Paul Scotton, and Charlie Miller provided the Nakamichi 300 source [7]
- **gd1980-12-26.157697.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Wiseman, Scott Clugston; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [8]
